subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this issue remain the umbrella for Control UI structured reply metadata plus no-output semantics, or should it be split/closed once the reply metadata PR and final fallback issue are explicitly linked?
rationale: The remaining work crosses UI, gateway protocol, agent runtime context, session/message delivery, and final fallback product semantics, and current main plus related issues only partially cover the request.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella Until Both Slices Resolve
options.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer-approved structured reply metadata path lands and the no-output/fallback slice is resolved or explicitly delegated to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

options.title: Split Into Canonicals Now
options.body: Close or narrow this issue after filing/linking separate canonical work for Control UI structured reply metadata and no-output/fallback delivery semantics.

options.title: Close As Partial Duplicate
options.body: Close this issue in favor of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88032, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561, accepting that no single linked item preserves the full original umbrella.

recommendation.title: Keep As Umbrella Until Both Slices Resolve
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer-approved structured reply metadata path lands and the no-output/fallback slice is resolved or explicitly delegated to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.
